# rhwp attribution

Dawith Welfare Office includes the browser HWP/HWPX reader from `edwardkim/rhwp`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/edwardkim/rhwp
- Pinned engine: v0.8.7, commit `1a76570e833917d15817415a53c09ad61ab3203f`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Bundled dependency notices: `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`

The engine is loaded only when the HWP/HWPX tool is opened. Documents are processed locally in the browser or packaged desktop app.
